$brand.name: forest
$brand.description: Organic green UI with serif headings, generous spacing, soft raised surfaces and pill actions.

onColor.$description: Fixed white on colored fills — green.600 fill gives ~7.5:1 vs white

accent.$description: Accent fill. light=green.600 (~7.5:1 white text), dark=green.500 (~5.1:1 white text). Both clear AA 4.5:1.

accentSubtle.$description: Subtle emerald tint for selected/current nav items — cool, calm depth

subtle.$description: Soft green wash for hover/secondary surfaces — organic, spacious

softer.$description: Success softer wash — uses emerald for cool-depth success tint in forest brand
Info softer wash — lime tint for fresh, organic info surface

focus.$description: Focus border — deep forest green for visibility

default.$description: Default border — soft green wash replaces neutral gray for organic feel

hover.$description: Hover border — cool emerald depth on interact

light.$description: Light border — fresh lime tint, barely-there edge

primary.$description: Primary border — cool emerald, neutral-ish but with forest character

default.$description: Primary action fill — green.600 clears AA (~7.5:1 vs white) in both light and dark

highlight.$description: Status highlight — lime for fresh, organic vitality signal (foreground/badge fill, not white-text fill)

default.$description: Default small control corner; content surfaces and actions have component-specific shape decisions.

near.$description: Near card elevation — raised surface, soft layered shadow

default.$description: Default card elevation — floating surface, gentle lift

far.$description: Far card elevation — overlay depth, calm prominence

none.$description: No elevation — flush with the earth

light.$description: Light card border — lime tint, barely-there fresh edge

medium.$description: Medium card border — cool emerald depth at subtle weight

dark.$description: Dark card border — visible green, grounded

focusWidth.$description: Input focus border width — soft emphasis (2px)

easing.$description: Soft organic easing — gentle acceleration, natural feel

weight.$description: Regular body weight (400) — easy reading, natural

inset.$description: Compact card variant retains less padding than the default surface.
